data.train_only_for_observer_basis: ROC05A high512 or low4 matched train source corresponding to frozen model arm
data.dev_for_interventions: all exactly 256 previously exposed ROC05A development records on 256 distinct new permutation tables
data.original_roc02_sealed_policy: ABSOLUTE EXCLUSION: do not read, generate or score original ROC02 family 6/7 test cases
data.roc05_reserved_pool: 384 newly reserved table identities remain ungenerated and unscored throughout ROC05B
data.roc04_consumed_pool: all 1152 prior ROC04 identities excluded from source population
data.exact_oracle: source A table queried row, plus symbolic_execute, for both unedited and legal source-row-swap inputs

observations.midpoint: after all source events EXCEPT final visible query (which is passed separately to readout), plus first four of eight original tied recurrent residual steps
observations.suffix: remaining four tied residual steps; original frozen model table_head, and same fixed 8-way query row selection
observations.verify_native_forward: unperturbed staged midpoint+suffix logits must agree with original QueryConditionedTableMemory.forward to absolute max 1e-5
observations.observer_basis: train-only centered cross-covariance SVD of 1024 midpoint hidden states vs centered one-hot correct queried-answer labels; top exactly 7 left singular vectors; shape 128x7; 8th singular direction is noncanonical
observations.random_controls: independent per model/query/radius rank-7 Haar/QR subspace and 128 rank-conditional null bases per calibration shadow state
observations.jacobian: T=dF_suffix^4/dh at each declared shadow midpoint; D=T-I (computed-change); analytic PyTorch-tanh dense Jacobian with chronological chain rule
observations.coupling: A=U^T D U, B=U^T D (I-UU^T), C=(I-UU^T) D U; report raw and /||D||F and same-rank random median ratios
observations.output_gram: H=(R_q T)^T(R_q T) with R_q the original frozen 8-logit row of table_head for that case's fixed final visible query; s=tr(U^T H U)/trH
observations.six_direction_holm: a_low, b_low, c_low, b_high, s_high, s_low, one-sided inclusive rank p=(1+extreme)/129, Holm adjustment across all six directions; undefined denominators abstain; ROC01 Amendment C preserved
observations.classifications: exploratory calibration-only tags, nonexclusive and abstention allowed; do not claim complete ROC01 mechanism identification

interventions.legal_early_source_edit: swap initial source A rule table output values at queried q and q+4 mod8; preserve all distractors/delay/final query, require new yprime distinct from old y
interventions.label_preserving_placebo: change first B/C distractor's rule table where possible, preserve correct A answer; report when ineligible
interventions.controlled_midpoint_L2: physical radius in 128D hidden midpoint measured against the SAME original h_mid, before four-step suffix
interventions.original_discrete_edit: full legal source-rule table edit at natural unequal hidden L2; report its own exact task oracle and native correctness separately
interventions.off_manifold_input: soften the table features along x(t)=x0+t(xcf-x0) and use fixed 64-point t grid plus 24 bisections to find first midpoint hidden norm crossing r; off-manifold intermediate input has no exact symbolic rule label; abstain if unachievable
hidden_arms: supervised-rank7-observed P_U delta/source edit, normalized to r
train-only-PCA-rank7-observed projection of source delta, normalized to r
full input-induced delta normalized to r, injected at hidden midpoint
SHA-keyed rank7 Gaussian observed random direction normalized to r
SHA-keyed 128D isotropic random direction normalized to r
interventions.validity: record actual injected L2 and input interpolation residual <=2e-5; invalid and zero-span projections are explicit abstentions; no clipped or fabricated radius
interventions.report_original_logits: unchanged native output after four suffix steps, not refitted observer predictions
interventions.output_metric: g(z';z,y,yprime)=(z'[yprime]-z'[y])-(z[yprime]-z[y]) under fixed final query; record margins, original/edited oracle correctness and argmax flips

primary.arm: high512 models, trained supervised rank-7 observed-source projection
primary.comparator: same-model, same-case, same-radius OFF-MANIFOLD soft-source-input edit
primary.case_scope: paired eligibility on all 256 dev records per model (same legal edit), require >=80% pairs valid per model
primary.per_seed: mean across eligible cases of g(rank7_observed_source)-g(soft_source_input) with frozen original model logits
primary.direction: rank7 observed-source positive relative to equal-radius soft input
primary.acceptance: at least 5 of six positive model-seed differences, positive six-seed mean, one-sided exact 64-sign signflip p<=0.05, and >=80% eligible case pairs in each of six high512 seeds; otherwise FAIL or explicit ABSTAIN for insufficient paired cases
primary.fixed_inference_unit: six independent model seeds; dev cases are paired inside seed, not independent model replicates
primary.selection_exposure: ROC05A dev answer-accuracy results were seen before ROC05B protocol freeze; this is calibration/development diagnostic and not independent model/test confirmation

descriptive.compare_low4: same exact causal routes for low4 arm, report differences by paired seed
descriptive.task_spec: actual correct-new-target rate under legal source edit; pairwise original/changed correctness and label-preserving distractor invariance
descriptive.overall: all per-case data and six-model statistics, per-state 128-null calibration receipts, SHA manifests
descriptive.claim_boundary: failure or success of this one rank7 hidden intervention is not a full five-type mechanism diagnosis; no new model adaptation and no reserved/test data

stop: any frozen model or source SHA mismatch
